```{r}
source('report_helpers.R')
b <- read_bundle(params$data_dir)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=7,fig.height=3.8)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(knitr::is_html_output()) cat(findings_html(b))
if(knitr::is_latex_output() && presentation_profile(b)$layout == 'editorial') {
  p <- presentation_profile(b)
  cat('Audience: **',p$display_name,'**. Presentation: ',p$layout,'.\n\n',sep='')
  cat('Selected diseases: ',paste(label_topic(b,group_topics(b)),collapse=', '),'.\n\n',sep='')
  cat('Notifications are not all infections. Surveillance and testing affect these descriptive comparisons; they do not establish causes or statistical significance.\n\n')
  cat('## What changed since ',b$cfg$reference_year,'?\n\n',sep='')
  cat('**',if(b$cfg$geography=='CHFL') 'Switzerland + Liechtenstein' else 'Switzerland',' · ',paste(b$cfg$years,collapse='–'),'**\n\n',sep='')
  cat('Snapshot: `',substr(b$manifest$snapshot_id,1,16),'`.\n\n',sep='')
  if(show_section(b,'headline')) {
    for(subject in c('viral:main','bacterial:main','viral:sensitivity')) {
      if(!paste0(subject, ':reference_change') %in% b$metrics$metric_id) next
      if(subject=='viral:sensitivity' && !length(b$cfg$sensitivity_exclude)) next
      label <- switch(subject,'viral:main'='Viral notifications','bacterial:main'='Bacterial notifications','viral:sensitivity'=paste('Viral without',sensitivity_label(b)))
      cat('- **',label,': ',format_pct(metric_value(b,paste0(subject,':reference_change'))),'** in ',report_year(b),' compared with ',b$cfg$reference_year,'.\n',sep='')
    }
  }
  cat('\nFull selection rules, source records and calculation references are in the companion [Methods & sources report](methods.pdf).\n\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(knitr::is_latex_output() && presentation_profile(b)$layout == 'editorial' && show_section(b,'group_totals')) {
  cat('\n## How many cases were reported?\n\n')
  print(plot_group_totals(b))
  cat('\nSource: FOPH national annual case series, summed over the selected diseases. COVID-19, AIDS and sentinel estimates are excluded from the default group totals. Only configured reporting and reference years are shown.\n\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if(knitr::is_latex_output() && presentation_profile(b)$layout == 'editorial' && show_section(b,'group_index')) {
  cat('\n## How have the groups changed?\n\n')
  print(plot_groups(b))
  cat('\nSource: the same selected case series. Each line shows percentage change from its own ',b$cfg$index_base_year,' total; zero means unchanged. This compares trends, not absolute disease burden.\n\n',sep='')
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4.7
if(knitr::is_latex_output() && presentation_profile(b)$layout == 'editorial' && show_section(b,'small_multiples')) {
  cat('\n## Which diseases changed most?\n\n')
  print(plot_changes(b))
  cat('\nSource: selected FOPH national case counts. Right of zero means more notifications; left means fewer. Percentages do not indicate severity or statistical significance.\n\n')
}
if(knitr::is_latex_output() && presentation_profile(b)$layout == 'editorial' && show_section(b,'change_table')) {
  cat('\n## Supporting figures\n\n')
  print(knitr::kable(friendly_table(b),row.names=FALSE))
  cat('\nSource: selected FOPH annual national case counts. Change = (latest count − baseline count) ÷ baseline count × 100. Values are rounded for display.\n\n')
}
```
